name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says 'Take the key, then open the door' — a stated order, so the last hard step (door_open) gets Existence plus Precedence(has_door_key, door_open), which together force has_door_key. That makes the hard Existence(has_door_key) (R1) redundant, repeating what the other hard clauses already force; the compiler's Redundant clue confirms it. Remove Existence(has_door_key); keep Existence(door_open), Precedence(has_door_key, door_open), the soft Existence(target_picked_up), and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up).
